title: eludite.forge.pull_merge input
description: Merge a pull request with `method` (`merge`, `squash`, `rebase`; GitLab's `fast_forward` or `semi_linear` as the project allows; Azure DevOps' `merge` (no fast-forward), `squash`, `rebase`, `rebase_merge`), or with `when_checks_pass` set it to merge when its checks pass (auto-merge, merge when pipeline succeeds, auto-complete). Refuses when the forge reports it unmergeable (conflicts, blocked, draft) or its checks failing unless `force`; `force` is refused for agents. The window asks first, naming the method. Dangerous.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous; for an agent the solution policy's `forge.merge` decides: `deny` (the default) refuses, `prompt` asks. `force` is refused for agents outright.

number.description: The number (GitHub, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps, Forgejo, Gitea). Give `number` or `id`.

id.description: The item's `id` as a list answered it; Tangled's items have only this (their AT-URI). Give `number` or `id`.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).

title.description: The merge or squash commit's title.

delete_branch.description: Delete the source branch after merging.

force.description: Merge although checks fail. Refused for agents.
